title: PAN
text:
[ I selected "Driving Licence" on the PAN application page, but I don’t have my Driving Licence issued inside my DigiLocker account. What should I do?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-23)
Your DigiLocker document selection must exactly match the choice you made on the PAN application page. If your Passport is not available in your DigiLocker vault, you cannot switch it directly inside the DigiLocker interface. Instead, you must cancel the current fetch process, return to the Protean PAN application screen, select a different valid proof (such as your Driving Licence) from the dropdown list, and then click "Fetch via DigiLocker" again to log in and retrieve that specific document. [ Is it safe to share my documents via DigiLocker?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-24)
Yes, completely. DigiLocker is a secure cloud-based platform provided by the Government of India. The platform shares your document data in an encrypted, digitally signed XML format. Protean only accesses the specific document you explicitly give consent to share. [ What happens if the DigiLocker system fails or cannot fetch my document?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-25)
If there is a technical error, a network issue, or your document isn't supported, the application will smoothly fall back to the standard manual submission mode. You will be able to scan and upload your documents manually just as before, ensuring your application process isn't lost. [ Will I still get confirmation messages about my application status?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-26)
Yes. All standard communication protocols remain exactly the same. You will receive real-time updates, token generation emails, payment receipts, and acknowledgment numbers via your registered email and mobile number, just at a much faster processing speed. [ Who should I contact if I encounter errors while registering with DigiLocker or am unable to pull my documents?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-27)
Errors encountered while registering with DigiLocker or issues with pulling documents from DigiLocker are not handled by Protean. Applicants need to get in touch directly with the DigiLocker helpdesk to resolve such concerns. **पैन**
  
  

[ पैन क्या है? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#hindi-01)
परमानेंट अकाउंट नंबर (पैन), एक दस अंकों का अल्फान्यूमरिक आइडेंटिफायर (पहचानकर्ता) है, जिसे आयकर विभाग द्वारा जारी किया जाता है। प्रत्येक ऐसेसी (यानी व्यक्ति, फर्म, कंपनी आदि) को एक अद्वितीय पैन जारी किया जाता है।
[ पैन के लिए कौन आवेदन कर सकता है? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#hindi-02)
सभी मौजूदा ऐसेसी या करदाता या व्यक्ति, जिन्हें आय का रिटर्न दर्ज करना आवश्यक है, भले ही किसी की ओर से दर्ज कर रहे हो, उनके पास पैन होना अनिवार्य है। कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो आर्थिक या वित्तीय लेनदेन करना चाहता है, जहाँ पैन दर्ज करना अनिवार्य है, उनके पास भी पैन होना अनिवार्य है।
[ नाबालिग, पागल, मूर्ख, मंद बुद्धी, मृत और अदालत के वार्ड्स की ओर से कौन आवेदन कर सकता है?
